confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors track Florence closely; accommodation, especially July peak-season hostel and 3-star rates, is least certain. Cocktail and wine derive from the beer anchor (cocktail about 1.7x draught beer, wine glass about 0.85x) because direct price knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Florence is the primary comparable (same country, similar tourist profile). Restaurant and coffee anchors sit near Florence, while hostel and 3-star hotel anchors are set above Florence to reflect Rome's larger July demand. Edinburgh and Helsinki bound the range but were not used directly.
